record_contract.dimensions: Named dimensions each carry state VALIDATED_BY_EVIDENCE or PENDING and an actual written rationale.
record_contract.scope: Only the explicitly reviewed dimensions are credited by evidence: programme, science, pedagogy, editorial and applicable specialized checks. Human approvals are consumed exclusively by HUMAN_REVIEW_GOVERNANCE.
record_contract.inheritance: No automatic inheritance. An identical body does not establish identical programme, parent-object or pedagogical review scope.
